WorkingPattern.title: Working pattern
WorkingPattern.description: The contracted hours one employee works on each weekday, over a dated period. A contract change is a NEW pattern with its own validFrom, never an edit of the running one, so a figure computed over a past period still divides by the contract that was in force then (working-hours-per-person, design D2). Hours are stored per weekday rather than as a full-time fraction: two people on 0.6 fte can work entirely different days, and a planner that only knows the fraction gets both wrong (design D4). Two patterns for one employee whose periods overlap are refused.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee this pattern belongs to.

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: The first day this pattern applies.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: The last day this pattern applies. Leave empty while it is the running pattern.
validUntil.x-notes: Inclusive end date; null means open-ended. A new pattern ends the running one rather than editing it.

note.title: Note
note.description: Why this pattern was written, in one line.

NonWorkingTime.title: Non-working time
NonWorkingTime.description: A day, a part of a day or a recurring weekday one employee does not work, that is neither leave nor sickness: a standing free Wednesday, a reduced schedule during re-integration, an adjusted week. It draws down no leave balance and opens no sick-leave case, because nobody requests it and nothing is deducted from it (working-hours-per-person, design D3). Leave stays in LeaveRequest and sickness in SickLeaveCase.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Who does not work this time.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this time is not worked. It is never a leave type.
reason.x-notes: Administered list. A value here never draws down a leave balance: leave is requested in LeaveRequest and sickness is recorded in SickLeaveCase.

recurringWeekday.title: Recurring weekday
recurringWeekday.description: The weekday this repeats on. Leave empty for a one-off period.
recurringWeekday.x-notes: When set, the entry applies to every occurrence of this weekday inside its start/end window (or for ever, when the window is open).

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: The first day this applies. Leave empty for a recurring weekday with no start.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: The last day this applies. Leave empty while it runs on.

hoursNotWorked.title: Hours not worked
hoursNotWorked.description: How many hours of the day are not worked. Leave empty for the whole day.
hoursNotWorked.x-notes: Null means the whole contracted day. A number subtracts that many hours from the day, never below zero, which is how a reduced afternoon is recorded.

note.title: Note
note.description: Anything the administrator should know about this arrangement.
